# Nationwide Traffic Drop on Public Holiday

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event
- **Confidence:** high (External event EVT-001 directly evidences a national public holiday starting at 2026-09-03 00:00, which explains the nationwide traffic and active user reduction. Network checks (T1, T4, T8) confirm no anomalies, maintenance, or relevant network failures contributed.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-03 07:15 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-03 00:00

## Summary

Nationwide public holiday causing reduced traffic and active users due to government offices and most businesses being closed.

Nationwide traffic volume and active users decreased below baseline starting at 2026-09-03 07:15 and remained lower through the end of the analysis window at 2026-09-03 08:49.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-03 00:00: EVT-001 nationwide public holiday started. [EVT-001, T3]
- 2026-09-03 01:35: CHG-2026-0003 software upgrade performed on S-SUD-003. [CHG-2026-0003, T8]
- 2026-09-03 07:15: Deviation onset observed where NATIONAL dl_volume_mb, ul_volume_mb, and active_users fell below baseline. [T2]

## Evidence

- No detector alerts occurred for the network between 2026-09-02 22:00 and 2026-09-03 08:49. [T1]
- NATIONAL dl_volume_mb, ul_volume_mb, and active_users showed deviations below baseline starting at 2026-09-03 07:15. [T2]
- A nationwide public holiday EVT-001 has been in progress since 2026-09-03 00:00 where government offices and most businesses are closed. [EVT-001, T3, T7]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on any node between 2026-09-03 00:00 and 2026-09-03 08:49. [T4]
- One software upgrade change (CHG-2026-0003) occurred on S-SUD-003 at 2026-09-03 01:35. [CHG-2026-0003, T8]

## Inferences

- The traffic drop is a direct consequence of reduced normal business and weekday usage due to the national public holiday. [EVT-001, T2]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event**: confirmed. EVT-001 public holiday explains lower traffic and active users due to business and government closures. [EVT-001, T2, T3]
2. **bad_change** at S-SUD-003: rejected. CHG-2026-0003 was isolated to S-SUD-003 and occurred hours before the nationwide traffic drop without triggering detector alerts. [CHG-2026-0003, T1, T8]
3. **transport_failure**: rejected. No anomalies or alerts were detected by the anomaly detector during the window. [T1]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0003: Change was isolated to node S-SUD-003 and did not affect nationwide infrastructure, nor did it trigger anomaly detector alerts.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor traffic recovery after the public holiday concludes.
